scope: Descriptive CAN channel agreement; scene-0001 is development only; no held-out confirmation or policy deployment
timestamp_unit: integer absolute microseconds; preserve native common clock
wheel_timestamp_semantics: CAN receipt time; physical measurement timestamp unavailable
pairing: latest wheel record at or before each pose; no interpolation, future lookup, time normalization, fitted offsets or residual filtering
wheel_speed: median of absolute RPM * (2*pi*0.305)/60 over all four wheels
pose_speed: hypot(vel[0],vel[1]); vel must contain three finite numeric components; localization comparator, not certified truth
invalid_numeric: reject booleans, strings, missing, NaN, infinity; negative native wheel RPM allowed
invalid_clocks: reject entire scene on duplicate, noninteger, negative or nonincreasing timestamps; never sort or deduplicate
invalid_latest: reject newest eligible wheel record; never fall back to an older valid record
denominator: retain every readable pose record, including missing/invalid wheel streams; report unknown pose denominators separately
caveat: agreement coverage is not policy availability; discrepancy is not physical error; CAN channels may share dependencies
cohort: all matching pose/zoe files in exact directory; retain missing, duplicate and invalid scenes; scene inventory does not establish full dataset completeness or independent logs
protected: do not open/hash/score Urban02 NIGHT, RAV4 or vehicle_final_evaluation payloads
